_rationale: After-tax pension $50k − living expenses $20k = $30k surplus per year. No income tax (Florida + after_tax), no portfolio growth. With no taxable account, ensureReinvestmentAccount auto-creates a $0 'Reinvestment' account. surplusContribution = $30k in every year; netCashFlow = $30k. After 5 years (index 5, age 75) the synthetic taxable balance is $150k; Roth stays at $0; portfolio total = $150k. Without auto-create the surplus would silently vanish and portfolio would stay at $0.
